biggest_catch: No bidding — clients browse and choose, so earnings depend entirely on your profile winning inbound interest in a competitive directory.
catches: No bidding mechanism: clients browse profiles or post projects and choose; you cannot pitch unprompted.
Strongest in France, UK, Germany, Spain, and the Netherlands — thinner elsewhere.
A platform service fee applies per engagement — check the current fee schedule at signup.
Competitive directory of 850k+ freelancers; profile quality and reviews drive visibility.
Payment timing follows Malt's payout flow — confirm current terms at signup.

c1.evidence: Malt's own site describes the marketplace: 'Pick from our talented community of over 850,000 freelancers... or get matched with the best available profiles for your project' and 'post your project on Malt and get replies from experts who match your needs' — a real, public client-to-freelancer deal channel.

c2.evidence: Official pages publish no fixed freelancer pay range — freelancers set daily rates (profiles show e.g. €350/day); framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: freelancer profile, client discovery or project post, direct chat, one-click quote acceptance, digital contract and payment workflow.

c4.evidence: Creating a freelancer profile is free; fees are charged on transactions, not upfront.

eligibility: Freelancers/consultants who can legally work with Malt's client base; strongest for Europe-based professionals.
notes: Scenario: freelance bidding / profile marketplace (no-bid variant). Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace: clients browse 850k+ freelancer profiles or post projects, and freelancers get contacted or reply with quotes. Income is per-engagement and variable — never guaranteed.
numeric_basis: payout: per-engagement, freelancer-set daily rates, no official fixed range. time: profile setup with skills/portfolio/rate + first project replies, est. 45-120 min active.

steps: Create a free Malt freelancer profile with skills, experience, daily rate, and portfolio.
Clients discover you by browsing profiles — or post a project and get replies from matching experts.
Chat directly with interested clients through the platform.
Accept the quote in one click; Malt handles the digital contract, NDA, invoicing, and payment workflow.
Deliver the work and get paid through Malt's payout flow.
timing: Clients typically find experts within days; project postings are continuous.
